title: Navigation Error Characteristics of LIO-, VIO-, and RIMU-Assisted INS/GNSS Multi-Sensor Fusion Schemes in a GNSS-Denied Environment
authors: Chiang K.-W.; Tsai S.; Huang C.-H.; Lu Y.-E.; Srinara S.; Tsai M.-L.; El-Sheimy N.; Ai M.
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Visual_LiDAR_Inertial_Fusion to ensure precise positioning.
